location.ref: Discourses on Radhasoami Faith, on spirit, mind and matter

paraphrase: Creation consists of three grand divisions: the purely spiritual above, the spiritual-material (mind) in the middle, and the material below; the spirit current descends through them and must re-ascend.
speaker: Brahm Shankar Misra
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only.
